schema_note: v4.3 无障碍设计意图映射 — 应对评审'机器视觉无法验证无障碍'与'每个场景同时提供五种模式'过度概括。每个设计元素映射到 GB 55019-2021 五个需求领域；mapping 标记为 design_intent_pending_field_audit；机器视觉自检不替代专业无障碍认证；现场认证由 P5 第三方无障碍审计承载。

standard.title_zh: 建筑与市政工程无障碍通用规范
standard.title_en: General code for accessibility of buildings and municipal engineering (translated title; Chinese original authoritative)
standard.issuer: 住房和城乡建设部（公告 2021 年第 174 号）
standard.nature: 强制性工程建设规范（全文强制，共 108 条）

requirement_areas: 无障碍设施施工验收和维护

mappings.element_zh: 全域慢行无障碍通行带
mappings.design_commitment_zh: 全线无高差通行，轮椅环通
mappings.design_commitment_en: Step-free travel along the full line with wheelchair circulation

mappings.element_zh: 六站厅无障碍出入口与电梯
mappings.element_en: Accessible entrances and lifts of the six halls

mappings.element_zh: 六站厅无障碍卫生间/厕位
mappings.element_en: Accessible toilets/compartments of the six halls
mappings.design_commitment_zh: 每站至少 1 处无障碍厕位 + 1 处母婴室
mappings.design_commitment_en: Each hall has at least 1 accessible compartment + 1 family room

mappings.element_zh: AI 服务点无障碍交互接口
mappings.element_en: Accessible interaction interfaces at AI service points
mappings.design_commitment_zh: 语音、字幕、大字、触屏、手势五模式；WCAG-2.2-AA 数字界面
mappings.design_commitment_en: Voice, captions, large text, touch, gesture five modes; WCAG-2.2-AA digital interface

mappings.element_zh: 银龄 AI 邻里客厅（SC-AI-SEN）
mappings.design_commitment_zh: AI 后台、人工前台、全人工保留入口、家属短信确认、可拒绝触发降级
mappings.design_commitment_en: AI backend, human front desk, fully-manual retention, family SMS confirmation, refusal-triggered downgrade
mappings.requirement_area: 无障碍服务设施 + 无障碍信息交流设施

mappings.element_zh: 数据要素服务楼（SC-AI-08）无障碍柜台
mappings.element_en: Accessible counter at Data-Element Service Building (SC-AI-08)
mappings.design_commitment_zh: 低位柜台 + 手语视频客服 + 文字交流板
mappings.design_commitment_en: Low counter + sign-language video service + text communication board

mappings.element_zh: 施工验收与无障碍设施维护
mappings.element_en: Construction acceptance and accessibility facility maintenance
mappings.design_commitment_zh: 试点启动前第三方审计（P5）；运营期每年复审
mappings.design_commitment_en: Third-party audit before pilot launch (P5); annual re-audit during operation
mappings.requirement_area: 无障碍设施施工验收和维护
